title: Philips TV will not power on
shortDescription: TV unresponsive with no standby light.
fullDescription:
Philips power failures most commonly trace to PSU issues, especially on older 4000/5000 series. Newer Ambilight OLED+ models have more reliable PSUs.

Firmware corruption can also cause boot failures - the standby LED may glow but TV won't fully start.
videoSearchQuery: Philips TV won't turn on fix

faq.a: Yes - parts are available though sometimes ordered through Europe.

title: Philips Android TV stuck
fullDescription:
Philips Android TV models can freeze on the loading splash, often due to cache or app issues. Power cycle or USB recovery resolves most cases.

Newer Google TV models behave similarly with cache buildup.

fixSteps.title: Clear cache
fixSteps.instruction: Settings > Apps > Clear cache for problem app.

faq.a: Yes - factory reset clears all preferences.

title: Ambilight LEDs not lighting
shortDescription: Ambient LED lighting around TV doesn't work.
fullDescription:
Ambilight is Philips's signature feature. When it fails, common causes are the feature being disabled in settings, individual LED strip failure, or a firmware bug after updates.

Partial Ambilight (some sides not working) usually indicates individual LED strip failure.

fixSteps.title: Enable Ambilight
fixSteps.instruction: Settings > Ambilight > Ambilight Style > pick a mode.

fixSteps.title: Service LED strip
fixSteps.instruction: If only some sides work, LED strip needs replacement.

faq.q: Can I replace just one LED strip?
faq.a: Yes - they're individual; match the model number.

title: HDMI input shows no signal
fullDescription: Philips TV no signal issues are usually wrong input or cable problems. HDMI Ultra HD setting needs to be enabled per port for 4K HDR.

fixSteps.title: Enable HDMI Ultra HD
fixSteps.instruction: Settings > General > HDMI Ultra HD > UHD per port.

faq.a: Philips's name for full HDMI 2.0/2.1 bandwidth mode.

title: Philips TV no audio
fullDescription:
Philips TVs sometimes have no sound due to Bowers & Wilkins audio settings (on premium models) being misconfigured, or output set to external.

Dolby Atmos passthrough mismatches are common with non-Atmos soundbars.

fixSteps.title: Set to PCM
fixSteps.instruction: Sound > Advanced > Digital Out Format > PCM.

faq.a: Bowers & Wilkins tunes audio on premium Philips OLED+ models.

title: Software update did not install
fullDescription: Philips updates can fail due to network or storage. Philips supports USB updates - download firmware from Philips support.

fixSteps.title: USB update
fixSteps.instruction: Download firmware from Philips support, copy to USB.

faq.a: Philips support site - search exact model number.

title: EasyLink HDMI-CEC not working
fullDescription: EasyLink is Philips's HDMI-CEC. Failures usually trace to it being disabled or partner CEC off.

fixSteps.title: Enable EasyLink
fixSteps.instruction: Settings > Channels > Channel settings > EasyLink ON.

title: Vertical lines on display
fullDescription: Vertical lines on Philips TVs indicate T-CON or panel issue. OLED panels can also show vertical bands of varying brightness due to non-uniformity, which is different from line failure.

fixSteps.title: Confirm internal
fixSteps.instruction: Lines on menu confirm internal fault.

faq.q: Are OLED bands the same as lines?
faq.a: No - bands are panel non-uniformity; lines are hard failures.

title: Netflix doesn't load on Philips
shortDescription: Netflix app crashes or fails to start.
fullDescription: Netflix on Philips Android TV occasionally fails after app updates conflicting with TV's OS. Cache clear or reinstall fixes most cases.

faq.a: Yes if reinstall - have credentials ready.

title: Philips remote not working
fullDescription: Philips offers IR and Bluetooth remotes. Voice/Google Assistant remotes need BT pairing.

fixSteps.title: Re-pair BT
fixSteps.instruction: Hold OK + back 5 seconds near TV.

videoSearchQuery: Philips TV remote not working fix

faq.q: How to test if remote dead?
faq.a: Use phone camera to check IR LED flashes when buttons pressed.
